critical_power_dialog.desc1:
This is the physiological threshold between long efforts (aerobic)
and short efforts (anaerobic). At Frive, this corresponds to the maximum power over 30 minutes.
critical_power_dialog.desc2: To determine your critical power, we use your power data. For an accurate estimate, we recommend you perform a test over 5 and 15 minutes.
critical_power_dialog.desc3:
Critical power can vary depending on your fatigue, motivation, stress...
If in doubt, you can try to perform a 30-minute test (=CP).
critical_power_dialog.desc4: It represents your ability to produce explosive and high-intensity efforts over short durations. Above your CP, you consume your reserve. Below, it recharges.
critical_power_dialog.desc5: It indicates the maximum power you can maintain for each duration of effort. It reflects your performance across all types of intensity, from sprinting to endurance.

performance.title: Performance Pack
performance.subtitle: The Performance Pack gives you access to the essential tools of Frive to progress quickly towards a short-term goal.
performance.imgtxt: The beginner or experienced athlete who wants to progress quickly to prepare for a unique medium-term goal. 80% of users only use this pack.
bullets: Training plan up to 3 months and 1 goal
Sending sessions to the bike computer
Tracking your activities on the agenda pages
Standard estimation of physiological profile (V02 max, notes, fatigue and performance indices)
Tracking your activities on the agenda pages

training.title: Coaching + Module
training.subtitle: The Coaching + module gives you access to all the features of training planning. It ensures you have a 100% tailored and adaptive program that keeps you on track throughout the season.
training.imgtxt: The competitor who wants to take a step forward and perform at the highest level with a long and effective preparation.
bullets: Training plan up to 1 year and 3 goals
Program that adapts to your fitness level

analyse.title: Analysis + Module
analyse.subtitle: The Analysis + module gives you access to an estimation of your physiological capacities (aerobic and anaerobic) and a comparative analysis with the sessions of your training plan.
analyse.imgtxt: The data enthusiast who wants to understand their strengths and weaknesses, track their progress, and know their physiological potential.
bullets: Advanced calculation of your physiological profile using AI
Comparison between planned and completed sessions
Estimation of your best possible performance on the climbs of each outing

nutrition.title: Nutrition + Module
nutrition.subtitle: The Nutrition + module allows you to know how to properly fuel yourself just before, during, and after a training session or competition. It also indicates the amounts of macronutrients consumed during the session.
nutrition.imgtxt: The athlete who wants to eat optimally to maximize their recovery and performance at the end of the session.
bullets: Nutrition and hydration to respect for approaching your session in the best conditions
Nutritional strategy for hydrating and properly fueling yourself during effort
Recommendations for recovering as quickly as possible after your session
Your energy expenditure during the session by macronutrients (protein, fat, carbohydrate)

effort.title: Effort + Module
effort.subtitle: The Effort + module offers you the optimal effort strategy to follow during an official race (Etape du Tour, GF Mont Ventoux...). You know what power to develop based on the course to achieve your best performance.
effort.imgtxt: The competitor who wants to achieve the best possible ranking on their goals by perfectly managing their effort.
bullets: Power strategy adapted to your physical capabilities and the course of your race
Impact of the bike, your equipment, and your weight on the performance achieved
Sending the effort management strategy to supported devices

pack_performance.title: Performance Pack
pack_performance.subtitle: The Performance Pack gives you access to the essential tools of Frive to progress quickly towards a short-term goal.

pack_coaching.title: Coaching Pack
pack_coaching.subtitle: The Coaching Pack includes all the features of the Performance Pack and the Coaching + module. It is the solution for a competitor who wants a 100% personalized plan that adapts to their fitness level.

pack_progress.title: Complete Pack
pack_progress.subtitle: The Complete Pack includes all the features of the Performance Pack and the Coaching + and Analysis + modules. It is the solution for the ultimate competitor who wants to progress as quickly as possible.

segments.connect_services: Connect your services to see your performances
segments.with_power_data: With power data, you could access:
segments.best_performance: Your best possible performance on legends like Alpe d'Huez
segments.effort_strategy: The effort management strategy to implement to go as fast as possible
segments.friends_ranking: A ranking of your performances and your friends on legendary segments
segments.mont_ventoux_desc: Mont Ventoux is one of the most difficult climbs in France. Its last kilometers offer a breathtaking lunar landscape, exposed to the wind.
segments.stelvio_desc: The Stelvio Pass is a long and exhausting climb. Its summit, located nearly 2800m above sea level, is often snow-covered during the Giro.
segments.zoncolan_desc: Monte Zoncolan is probably the most formidable climb in Europe. With its extreme slopes, the gaps at the summit can be enormous.
segments.huez_desc: Alpe d'Huez is a beyond category pass. Its 21 turns constitute an essential climb where the Tour de France has often changed course.
segments.angliru_desc: The Angliru, with its frightening slopes, is a very difficult climb in the Vuelta. This ascent usually sees a very good climber prevail.
segments.huy_desc: The Mur de Huy is a short climb with very steep sections that serves as a judge of peace for the prestigious Belgian race La Flèche Wallonne.
segments.poggio_desc: The Poggio is the last climb of Milan-San Remo, a "Monument" race of 300km. It offers punchers an opportunity to distance sprinters before the finish located 6km from the summit.
segments.belles_filles_desc: La Planche des Belles Filles is a new addition to the Tour de France. This fairly difficult climb features a steep and unpaved finish.
segments.paris_roubaix_desc: Paris-Roubaix is one of the 5 monuments of cycling. These legendary cobbled sectors like Carrefour de l'arbre are extremely demanding.
segments.flanders_desc: The Tour of Flanders is a classic that has become famous for its legendary cobbled hills like Koppenberg or Vieux Quaremont where favorites often compete for victory.
